scripts.dev: npm run build -w @local-agent/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @local-agent/server" "npm run dev -w @local-agent/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @local-agent/shared && npm run build -w @local-agent/server && npm run build -w @local-agent/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @local-agent/shared && npm run typecheck -w @local-agent/server && npm run typecheck -w @local-agent/web
